title: Reorder List
statement: Reorder the list in place so it interleaves front and back: first, last, second, second-last, and so on. Return nothing; the list itself is checked.
hints: First find the midpoint with slow and fast pointers, and cut the list in two.
Reverse the second half, then weave the two halves together one node at a time. Remember to null out the first half tail before reversing, or you build a cycle.
